items.t: Marvell in Talks to Buy Nvidia-Backed Lumentum
items.d: Marvell Technology is in talks to buy data center optics maker Lumentum Holdings. The deal could close next week according to sources. Nvidia backs up Lumentum which has a market value of about $83 billion. Ryan Gould reports.  (Source: Bloomberg)

items.t: 골드만삭스, ‘내비 1위’ 티맵모빌리티 인수 추진
items.d: 골드만삭스가 국내 내비게이션 앱 1위인 티맵 운영사 티맵모빌리티 인수를 추진 중이다.  29일 재계와 투자은행(IB)업계에 따르면 골드만삭스는 티맵모빌리티 최대주주인 SK스퀘어와 경영권 인수를 두고 협상을 진행 중이다. 골드만삭스는 티맵모빌리티 인수 금액에 약 7000억∼8000억 원 정도를 투입해 지분의 60% 이상을 인수하겠다는 방침인 것으로 알려졌다.  SK텔레콤의 내비게이션 서비스로 시작된 티맵은 2020년 SK텔레콤이 모빌리티 사업부문을 물적분할해 티맵모빌리티를 설립하면서 운영사가 변경됐다. 티맵모빌리티는 2021년 SK스퀘어의 자회사가 됐다. 최근 SK그룹이 AI 인프라를 중심으로 사업을 재편함에 따라 SK스퀘어도 사업 포트폴리오 재편의 일환으로 티맵모빌리티 매각을 검토하는 것으로 보인다.  골드

items.t: Deepgram acquires Pipecat-maker Daily to bolster its voice AI infrastructure
items.d: With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure.
items.fullText: The voice AI sector is hot, and top players are trying to consolidate their position as more business models come to the fore through partnerships and acquisitions. Deepgram is the latest to make such moves: The company said on Thursday that it is acquiring Daily, the maker and maintainer of one of the most popular open source voice AI infrastructures, Pipecat. The companies didn’t disclose the deal amount but said that they will keep Pipecat open source. For the uninitiated, Pipecat is a framework that manages voice and video streams along with other pieces in the pipeline, like speech-to-text (STT), large language models (LLMs), and text-to-speech (TTS) models while reducing latency. Its maker, Daily, provides hosted infrastructure for voice and video calls of any kind. With Pipecat, Deepgram will likely gain a deeper understanding of real-time voice and video infrastructure. Daily has raised over $62 million in funding to date from investors such as Tiger Global, Highfield Capital, Nat Friedman, Lachy Groom, and Kevin Weil, according to PitchBook data. Earlier this year, Deepgram reached unicorn status with a $130 million Series C round . Incidentally, both companies were in the same Y Combinator batch in 2016. Kwindla Kramer, Daily’s co-founder, said around the time when GPT-4 came out, the company started experimenting with AI-to-human communication over voice and text, which eventually resulted in the Pipecat framework. He noted that while there has been a lot of acquisition interest, he favored Deepgram’s CEO Scott Stephenson’s commitment to keeping Pipecat open source forever, and the engineering culture of both organizations matched, giving Daily’s team the freedom to work on different parts of the stack within a bigger organization. “Scott was super committed to Pipecat being open source and vendor-neutral forever. Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
items.d: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure's quarterly revenue in dollars. But for the first time, we can see just how close it is getting to besting the biggest competitor in the market, AWS.
items.fullText: Microsoft has never disclosed Azure’s quarterly revenue in dollars. It has typically only shared a growth percentage or described revenue dollar milestones in vague ways. But on Wednesday, when it posted another record-breaking quarter , it reported that Azure brought in a healthy $33.2 billion in revenue for the July-September quarter, up 48% from a year earlier. The disclosure lets investors line up Azure’s performance more directly against Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud, whose parent companies already report cloud revenue in dollars every quarter. Alphabet, which also reported earnings on Wednesday, said Google Cloud brought in $30.7 billion in the same quarter, putting Azure slightly ahead. But Google Cloud, which also includes Google’s Workspace subscriptions, roughly doubled its revenue from a year earlier, growing about twice as fast as Azure, according to TechCrunch’s calculations. Azure, where businesses rent computing power to run applications, SaaS, and to build and run AI models, is now Microsoft’s largest and fastest-growing product line by the company’s own figures. It accounted for roughly 36% of Microsoft’s $92.3 billion in quarterly revenue. Azure’s revenue was also about $850 million more than the $32.3 billion analysts expected . Azure’s 48% growth rate also topped the 44% to 45% that Microsoft CFO Amy Hood forecast on the company’s July earnings call . Azure sits inside Agents and Infra, one of two new business segments Microsoft introduced this quarter. Microsoft previously reported three segments, Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing. The new Agents and Infra segment, which groups Azure with Microsoft 365’s cloud business, brought in $76.8 billion , up 25% from a year earlier. Amazon reports its earnings on Thursday. items.fullText: 모닝 글로벌 뉴스 '윈도우의 MS, 검색의 구글은' 옛말…데이터센터가 빅테크 효자 입력 2026.10.29 06:53 수정 2026.10.29 07:28 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 김인엽 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 인공지능(AI) 클라우드가 빅테크의 핵심 성장동력으로 부상한 가운데, 선제적 사업 전환으로 안정적인 현금흐름을 유지한 마이크로소프트와 대규모 설비투자 부담이 늘어난 구글·메타 간의 희비가 갈리고 있습니다. 구글 클라우드 매출 103%↑·MS 애저 48%↑ 클라우드가 양사 매출·이익 성장 견인 MS, 10여년 전부터 소프트웨어 클라우드 전환 AI 투자 후 MS 186억$ 흑자…구글 91억$ 적자 메타도 투자비가 영업현금흐름 웃돌아 사진=로이터 인공지능(AI) 클라우드가 빅테크의 새로운 성장동력으로 자리 잡고 있다. 구글과 마이크로소프트(MS)가 나란히 클라우드 사업에서 높은 매출·이익 증가율을 기록하며 AI 인프라에 대한 수요를 입증했다. 이 제는 막대한 투자비를 감당하는 능력이 경쟁력을 가르고 있다. 일찌감치 기업용 소프트웨어 사업을 클라우드 중심으로 전환한 MS는 설비투자 이후에도 현금을 남겼지만, 구글과 메타 등은 벌어들인 돈보다 더 많은 자금을 투자에 쏟아부었다. 수익성 입증한 클라우드 사업 구글 모회사 알파벳과 MS가 28일(현지시간) 발표한 올해 3분기 실적에 따르면 두 기업 모두 클라우드 사업이 급성장했다. 구글 클라우드 매출은 307억900만달러로 전년 동기 대비 103% 급증했다. 영업이익은 111억2100만달러로 209% 늘었다. 영업이익률은 23.7%에서 36.2%로 높아졌다. 기업들의 AI 모델 학습·추론 수요가 늘어나면서 클라우드 컴퓨팅 서비스뿐 아니라 구글이 자체 개발한 AI 반도체 텐서처리장치(TPU) 시스템 판매도 증가한 결과다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 김인엽 특파원 한국경제신문 실리콘밸리 김인엽 특파원입니다. 정치부, 국제부를 거쳐 테크앤사이언스부에 있습니다. 현재 실리콘밸리 빅테크와 스타트업, 캘리포니아에서 일어나는 흥미로운 일들을 취재하고 있습니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations October 21, 2026 by Mavi Nafria 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! European retailers are using open models and physical intelligence across use cases — from a commerce platform cutting inference costs by 90% to to a fulfillment center where collaboration of different robotic fleets is simulated inside a digital twin. Frontier Results With Open Models Retail leaders and technology companies across Europe are using NVIDIA-accelerated open and frontier models to advance agentic commerce, digital product discovery and retail R&D. Shopify post-trains open models to reach frontier-level accuracy at a fraction of the cost. Its engineers use the NVIDIA Megatron Bridge library for faster fine-tuning and NVIDIA NeMo RL for reinforcement learning. Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants. The subagent retrieves store data for several Sidekick features, including Sidekick Pulse, which researches a merchant’s store and recommends ways to improve it. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster. Beyond Sidekick, NVIDIA CCluster vLLM inference optimization software helped Shopify achieve 4.5x faster performance and up to 12x lower inference cost across five additional use cases: catalog enrichment, merchant assistant, e-commerce shopping simulation, product taxonomy classification, and merchant and buyer recommendations. items.fullText: Google Cloud and NVIDIA Announce General Availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin Infrastructure Google Cloud A5X instances, accelerated by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, support European innovators with next-generation agentic and reinforcement learning infrastructure. October 21, 2026 by Uttara Kumar 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! General availability of the instances is coming next month, with planned expansion of availability to Europe — bringing an integrated platform for training, inference and large-scale reinforcement learning to cloud customers. A5X instances bring together NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, NVIDIA ConnectX-9 SuperNICs, Google Cloud Virgo Network and Google Cloud’s fourth-generation advanced liquid-cooling technology for demanding agentic inference and reinforcement learning workloads at scale. Google Cloud plans to scale its Vera Rubin-based infrastructure to as many as 960,000 Rubin GPUs across multiple sites. Ineffable Intelligence , a London-based technology company founded by AlphaGo creator David Silver, was the first customer to access A5X. Ineffable is using the platform to advance large-scale reinforcement learning and shape “superlearner” systems that learn continuously from experience. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Learning through interaction requires a continuous cycle of generating experience, evaluating outcomes and updating models, requiring infrastructure that can support the entire process at scale.
